STEP 1 - Scene: A plated meal with a savory pie or quiche-like wedge (looks like a slice of meat/vegetable pie with a cheesy, golden top) and sliced cooked carrots. Photographed from above at a fairly top-down angle, on a glass surface.

STEP 2 - Ruler: The white plate is square-ish, roughly 24 cm across its width. Vessel area ≈ 24 x 24 x ~0.85 (rounded corners) ≈ 490 cm². I use ~480 cm².

STEP 3 - Items:
- Pie/quiche wedge (filling with meat, vegetables, cheese, pastry)
- Sliced cooked carrots (about 6 rounds/pieces)

STEP 4 - Area:
- Pie wedge: ~12% of plate area (about 58 cm²)
- Carrots: ~10% of plate area (about 48 cm²)
Total food covers ~22% of the plate, which is consistent with the visible footprint.

STEP 5 - Volume:
- Pie wedge: 58 cm² x ~2.5 cm height ≈ 145 ml
- Carrots: 48 cm² x ~1.2 cm (sliced rounds stacked) ≈ 58 ml

STEP 6 - Grams:
- Pie: 145 ml x 0.9 ≈ 130 g
- Carrots: 58 ml x 0.6 ≈ 35 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Pie wedge: 130 g x ~250 kcal/100 g ≈ 325 kcal (pastry-and-filling pie, cooked)
- Carrots: 35 g x ~35 kcal/100 g ≈ 12 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A single generous wedge of savory pie plus a modest portion of carrots at roughly 165 g total and ~340 kcal is plausible for what is visible on a roughly 24 cm plate.

Total: about 165 g, about 340 kcal.
